title: Canonicalize Target Graphql Operation Fields
description: Clean semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql operation field names so operation API names are action-first, e.g. createdDesign instead of designCreated.
summary: Removed obsolete concrete operation scope types from semio/graphql/target.schema.graphql after Operation.scope was converted to Entity references. Also removed stale empty Warning and duplicate Error interfaces so the SDL remains valid.
